why: Stops checking that Exit stayed on the deploy path. `exitDeveloperMode` composes `location.pathname` with the stripped search; a version that assumed the origin root would land on "/" -- fine on the root serve every other tool uses, and a 404 on Pages, which is precisely the class of defect this whole check exists for.
killedBy: exitContractFailures: judging where Exit landed FAILS when the exit leaves the deploy path
exitContractFailures: judging where Exit landed reports every breach at once rather than stopping at the first
